qualifications: Supplied GFF coefficients and SRI C1 calculation are not independently rederived here.
Baseline C1 is the retained correlator evaluation, not the midpoint of its conditional interval.
SRI interval retains the source spectral-gap and nonlinear-allowance assumptions; it is not a confidence interval.
Candidate action is exact for the critical real saddle; dominance and the full renormalized asymptotic power remain conditional.
No 3d instanton amplitude is calculated or borrowed from 1d.
All scan envelopes and input ranges are sensitivities, not physical error bars.
C0 through C7 retain their previous higher-precision sources; noisy lower-order cross-checks in the C8 campaign do not replace them. No joint covariance between retained campaigns is assumed.

C8_provenance.allowance_status: Empirical reporting allowance, not sampling SE or a confidence interval; adopted after production.
